title: Detroit Architect

basics.tagline: A conversational AI assistant for Detroit architecture

listing.shortDescription: A custom architecture practice website with an embedded AI chatbot built around the OpenAI GPT API and delivered through Chatbase.
listing.fullDescription: Detroit Architect is a focused digital presence for a licensed Detroit architecture practice, with a conversational AI assistant at the centre of the experience. The chatbot combines the OpenAI GPT API with a conversational delivery layer through Chatbase and Voiceflow-style flows, helping visitors understand services, ask project questions, and move naturally toward a consultation.

cover.imageAlt: Chatbot platform ecosystem covering Chatbase, Voiceflow, Landbot, ManyChat, Tidio, Intercom, Drift and related conversational AI tools

features.title: Embedded AI chatbot
features.description: A Chatbase-powered assistant is embedded directly into the architecture website so visitors can get help without leaving the page.

features.title: OpenAI GPT intelligence
features.description: The OpenAI GPT API provides the language intelligence for answering questions about architecture services, projects, and consultations.

features.title: Voiceflow conversation design
features.description: Voiceflow-style conversational flows shape the assistant's prompts, routing, tone, and handoff points for a more useful visitor experience.

features.title: Practice-aware answers
features.description: The chatbot experience is tailored around Detroit Architect's residential, commercial, public, and renovation services.

features.title: Consultation journey
features.description: Clear contact and booking paths turn useful chatbot conversations into the next step: starting a project consultation.

features.title: Responsive portfolio site
features.description: The surrounding website presents the practice, projects, credentials, and contact flow across desktop and mobile screens.

challenge.summary: The practice needed more than a polished architecture portfolio. Visitors also needed an immediate way to ask questions, understand the firm's capabilities, and decide whether to begin a conversation.

points.title: Visitors need immediate answers
points.description: Prospective clients may arrive with early questions about services, project types, process, or fit before they are ready to call.

points.title: The chatbot had to feel intentional
points.description: A generic support widget would feel disconnected from a considered architecture practice and its consultation-led journey.

points.title: Conversation needs a useful destination
points.description: The experience needed to guide visitors from an open-ended question toward relevant service information and a consultation enquiry.

solution.summary: We built a deliberately focused architecture website around an AI-first visitor experience: OpenAI GPT API for natural language responses, Voiceflow for conversation structure, and Chatbase for the embedded chatbot delivery layer.

points.title: OpenAI GPT API as the intelligence layer
points.description: GPT handles natural-language understanding and response generation, allowing the assistant to answer questions in a conversational way.

points.title: Voiceflow for conversation logic
points.description: Conversation flows define the assistant's tone, prompts, branches, and handoffs so the chatbot stays aligned with the practice's goals.

points.title: Chatbase for website delivery
points.description: Chatbase provides the embeddable chatbot layer, making the assistant available inside the public website through a lightweight script integration.

points.title: Chat-to-consultation handoff
points.description: The chatbot sits alongside clear contact paths, helping turn an exploratory visitor question into a qualified consultation opportunity.

objectives: Make an AI chatbot the primary interactive touchpoint on the architecture website
Use the OpenAI GPT API to provide natural, useful answers for prospective clients
Structure the conversational experience through Voiceflow-style flows and prompts
Deliver the chatbot through Chatbase as an embedded website experience
Connect visitor questions to Detroit Architect's services and consultation journey

closing.clientOverview: Detroit Architect is a licensed architecture practice serving clients from Highland Park and across Detroit, with work spanning custom homes, additions, multi-unit residential, commercial, public, institutional, renovation, and industrial projects. The website needed to communicate that breadth while giving prospective clients a more direct way to start a conversation.
closing.conclusion: The result is a sharp architecture portfolio with a conversational layer that does real work. OpenAI GPT API supplies the intelligence, Voiceflow shapes the conversation, and Chatbase puts the chatbot directly in front of visitors, making the website feel more responsive while preserving a clear path to consultation.
